Description: Extract a structured summary from a radiology report.

modality.description: The imaging modality used — CT, MRI, ultrasound, radiograph or mammography

body_region.description: The anatomical region examined, as named in the report

contrast_used.description: Whether intravenous contrast was given, as stated in the technique

primary_finding.description: The single most clinically important finding, in the report's own words

measurement_mm.description: The size in millimetres of the main lesion, if one is measured

recommendation.description: The follow-up action the report recommends, if any
